anchors.description: Horizontal span across the dark upholstered headboard behind the pillows, from its left edge to its right edge; this span equals the bed width class (queen/small double).
anchors.visible_evidence: The dark headboard panel is clearly visible above/behind the two patterned pillows; its left vertical edge sits just right of the left bedside lamp and its right edge ends where the warm-lit wall and right nightstand begin. The span is slightly wider than a standard mattress plus a small margin, consistent with a queen-class bed.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact bed size (full 1.37 m vs queen 1.53 m mattress) is not distinguishable; headboard may be a few cm wider than the mattress. Left edge is near the headboard/wall boundary so a small depth offset is possible.

anchors.description: Horizontal width of the left patterned pillow propped against the headboard, between its left and right visible edge.
anchors.visible_evidence: A patterned decorative pillow leaning on the headboard, with a second matching pillow beside it; both are roughly square in the image and of standard bed-pillow size, consistent with a 26 in (0.66 m) sham.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Whether it is a 20x26 in standard sham or a 26x26 in euro sham is unclear; rounding of the stuffed pillow edges can shorten the measured span slightly.

anchors.description: Vertical height of the left bedside lamp from the top of its drum lampshade down to the bottom of its base where it meets the nightstand top.
anchors.visible_evidence: The lamp stands vertically on the left nightstand: bright drum shade on top, black urn-shaped ceramic base below. Its shade is about 0.35-0.45 m across, which combined with the shade-to-base proportions gives a total height near 0.6 m.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: No brand or model is identifiable; bedside lamp heights range roughly 0.5-0.8 m, and the drum-shade diameter is only inferred from category priors.
